text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small, individual parts of the code, like a single function, to ensure they work correctly on their own. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of the system work well together. One popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a test first, watch it fail, and then write just enough code to make it pass. This method helps prevent bugs early. Ultimately, a good testing strategy gives developers confidence. They can change or improve code without worrying that they might accidentally break something that already worked.
